description: List your Vibo notifications (song additions, comments, DJ updates, etc.) with read state and linked event/section ids.

skip.description: Number of items to skip, for paging (default 0).

view.description: compact (default) strips image/avatar URLs; "full" returns Vibo's payload untouched; "brief" returns one line per notification: header — <ISO date | no date> — <read|unread>, inside the untrusted-data envelope, with "-- none" for none and "-- N of M shown" / "-- more" when partial.

name: vibo_list_notifications
